practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 100% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: Froholdt was a full practice participant both Thursday and Friday, and he's progressed enough in his recovery to clear the league's concussion protocol. With Jon Gaines (ankle) ruled out, Froholdt should reclaim his starting job at center for Sunday's road tilt.

practiceReport.name: Carson Beck
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (100% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Missed prior game without practice participation — awaiting Wednesday report
Early-week update (2 corroborated reports): unlikely to practice Wednesday / questionable at best
practiceReport.beatComment: Beck continues to deal with back spasms that sidelined him this past Sunday at Kansas City. LaFleur told Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site Wednesday that the team is preparing Josh Johnson to start Sunday's game against the Commanders, so Beck seemingly is in danger of missing a second straight contest.

practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (81%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Simon is being evaluated by medical staff to determine whether he can return to Sunday's contest. His absence gives the Cardinals less depth at linebacker behind Jack Gibbens, Mack Wilson and Zaven Collins.

practiceReport.name: Josh Minkins
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (78%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Minkins was not claimed off waivers and will now be waived off injured reserve with an injury settlement. The 24-year-old appeared in one preseason game for the Cardinals in 2026, recording two tackles (one solo) in the 42-38 loss to Green Bay on Aug. 28.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Zachary Carter
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Carter opened the regular season on injured reserve due to a knee injury he picked up in training camp in early August. He logged a trio of full practices during Week 11 prep but is not quite ready to return, so his next chance to make his 2026 debut is Week 12 against the Commanders on Sunday, Nov. 29.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jeremiyah Love
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Love must miss at least one more game due to the right high-ankle sprain that he picked up in a Week 8 win at Dallas, but the Cardinals have a decision to make next week, as they have a Week 13 matchup with the Eagles on tap before a Week 14 bye. For as long as Love is sidelined, Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight will continue to man Arizona's backfield.

irAndReserveTracker.name: James Conner
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 14 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Conner hasn't played in a game since Week 3 of last season, when he sustained a right foot/ankle injury that required surgery. Though he was able to participate in individual drills in training camp, he never advanced to team work before being placed on injured reserve with a designation to return Aug. 30. The Cardinals still haven't cleared Conner to practice nearly three months later, which suggests that he either experienced a setback over the summer or plateaued in his recovery. Whatever the case, Conner doesn't seem close to a return, and the chances of him playing at any point this season will grow dimmer with each week that he doesn't practice.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Andrew Wingard
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 14 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Wingard picked up a wrist injury in the team's 34-6 loss to the Rams in Week 10, and he will now be forced to miss at least four contests while recovering from the injury. In Wingard's absence, Kitan Crawford and Dadrion Taylor-Demerson are both candidates to replace him as the team's starting free safety Sunday versus the Chiefs.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tip Reiman
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Reiman hasn't played this season and is currently on the reserve/PUP list. While there haven't been any updates on when the 25-year-old will be back on the field, it appears the door isn't fully closed regarding his return before the end of the 2026 campaign. Reiman has appeared in 21 regular-season games for the Cardinals since being drafted in the third round in the 2024 NFL Draft, amassing nine catches for 55 yards.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Chase Bisontis
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Gardner Minshew II
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Though the procedure will bring an end to Minshew's season, he's expected to make a full recovery ahead of the 2027 campaign. The veteran quarterback sustained the injury while making his lone start of the season Week 9 in Seattle, but he played though the elbow issue and completed 21 of 30 passes for 166 yards. Rookie third-round pick Carson Beck took over as the Cardinals' starting quarterback in Week 10 and is expected to lead the offense for the remainder of the season.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jalen Brooks
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The transaction comes after Brooks announced earlier in the day that he underwent season-ending wrist surgery. Brooks saw light snaps through the first four weeks of the season, but he stepped in as the Cardinals' No. 3 wideout for the past three games after Marvin Harrison was traded to the Texans. The 26-year-old will finish the 2026 campaign with five receptions for 81 yards on 17 targets to go with 499 yards on 19 kickoff returns.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Joey Blount
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Jordan Burch
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: This move was a foregone conclusion, as head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Burch will miss the remainder of the campaign after suffering an MCL injury to his left knee. The defensive end finished his sophomore NFL season with 19 tackles, including 1.0 sacks, over 10 games. Burch will now look to get healthy in the hope of being ready for the 2027 campaign.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Kaleb Proctor
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Placed on Injured Reserve (Knee - Meniscus) on Jul 22, 2026; ineligible to return in 2026 under NFL CBA rules.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Kendrick Bourne
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Though Bourne is expected to avoid surgery after fracturing his right tibia during Sunday's 33-30 overtime win over the Cowboys, he's facing an expected recovery timeline of three months that effectively ends his season. With Bourne heading to IR, the Cardinals signed Harrison Wallace off their practice squad to replenish their depth at receiver. The 31-year-old Bourne will finish the 2026 campaign with 26 receptions for 263 yards and no touchdowns on 38 targets over eight appearances.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Michael Wilson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Wilson's move to IR was merely a formality, after head coach Mike LaFleur announced Monday that the wideout would be sidelined for the rest of the season after sustaining a fractured vertebra in his neck during Sunday's 17-3 loss to the Seahawks. Per Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com, Wilson is expected to be in a neck brace for the next six weeks to two months, but the Cardinals don't view the injury as a long-term or career-threatening concern. The 26-year-old receiver will finish the 2026 campaign with 51 receptions for 546 yards and two touchdowns on 88 targets to go with 28 rushing yards on three carries across his nine appearances.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Paris Johnson Jr.
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The moves comes after Johnson was diagnosed with a torn left biceps that he sustained toward the end of the Cardinals' Week 4 loss to the Giants. He'll spend the rest of the 2026 season on IR and aim to be fully healthy for the start of the 2027 campaign, which will be the final year of his rookie contract. Jayden Williams will be the starting left tackle for now, with Josh Fryar and the recently acquired Jedrick Wills (signed from the Bills' practice squad) providing depth at the position in Johnson's absence.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Trey Benson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Benson underwent surgery in early October last year for a meniscus injury he suffered in the Cardinals' Week 4 loss to the Seahawks, but after returning the running back could never get right and he had trouble staying on the practice field. The 24-year-old's struggles, combined with the Cardinals' crowded running back room, caused him to be placed on waivers to begin the week, and there were no takers. If he can fix his knee troubles he could negotiate an injury settlement in an attempt to find another team to play for in 2026.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Will Johnson
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Johnson suffered a neck injury in the 31-7 loss to the Seahawks in Week 2. He was placed on injured reserve, so he is guaranteed to miss at least four games. However, the 23-year-old isn't expected to play again this season. If that's the case, he will finish the year with eight total tackles (three solo), one fumble recovery and one pass defended. Without Johnson, Garrett Williams (Achilles), who has yet to play this season, could take on a larger role upon his return. Max Melton (toe), Kei'Trel Clark and Starling Thomas, the latter who was promoted from the practice squad, may also be more involved.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Xavier Weaver
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Weaver was set to miss the entire 2026 season after being placed on injured reserve Aug. 24 due to a hamstring injury. However, the settlement allows the Colorado product to sign and play with a team once he is fully healthy. Weaver appeared in 10 regular-season games for the Cardinals in 2025, recording seven catches (on 13 targets) for 67 yards.
